# `csharp_indent_switch_labels`

Indent case labels inside their switch.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `true`

## Examples

The snippet below is formatted with default options and then again with the option applied.

**Snippet (formatted with defaults):**

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public string Name(int code)
    {
        switch (code)
        {
            case 1:
                return "one";
            case 2:
                {
                    var msg = "two";
                    return msg;
                }
            default:
                return "other";
        }
    }
}
```

### `csharp_indent_switch_labels = true`

```editorconfig
csharp_indent_switch_labels = true
```

*No visible change on this snippet — the option affects other constructs.*

### `csharp_indent_switch_labels = false`

```editorconfig
csharp_indent_switch_labels = false
```

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public string Name(int code)
    {
        switch (code)
        {
        case 1:
            return "one";
        case 2:
            {
                var msg = "two";
                return msg;
            }
        default:
            return "other";
        }
    }
}
```
